scenarios.name: Basic product search
scenarios.user_message: I need a birthday cake for my wife
scenarios.expected_behavior: Search catalog for cakes, load wife's profile, filter out nut-containing items
scenarios.notes: Wife (Amaya) is allergic to nuts - any nut-containing cake must be filtered

scenarios.name: Preference update
scenarios.user_message: My wife is now also allergic to shellfish, please remember that
scenarios.expected_behavior: Update wife's allergy list to include shellfish in recipient_profiles.json

scenarios.name: Delivery logistics check
scenarios.user_message: Can you deliver a cake to Kandy by this Saturday?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Check Kandy delivery zone - cakes are perishable, Kandy is 2-day standard, check if Saturday is feasible
scenarios.notes: Perishable restriction test - cakes may not be deliverable to Kandy

scenarios.name: Allergy reflection trap
scenarios.user_message: Get me a nice chocolate gift box for my wife
scenarios.expected_behavior: Draft finds chocolate boxes, reflection catches nut-containing ones, revise suggests nut-free alternatives
scenarios.notes: Core reflection loop test - MUST catch nut allergies

scenarios.name: Budget-constrained search
scenarios.user_message: I want flowers for my mother, under 5000 rupees
scenarios.expected_behavior: Search flowers, filter by price <= 5000 LKR, check mother's profile

scenarios.name: Repeat order reference
scenarios.user_message: I want to send the same thing I got my wife last Valentine's day
scenarios.expected_behavior: Look up wife's past_gifts for valentines occasion, find Red Rose Bouquet
scenarios.notes: Tests semantic memory read for past gift history

scenarios.name: Unknown recipient
scenarios.user_message: I need a gift for my colleague Sarah
scenarios.expected_behavior: No profile found for Sarah - ask user for preferences, suggest generic safe options

scenarios.name: Cultural occasion - Avurudu
scenarios.user_message: I need an Avurudu gift for my mother in Kandy
scenarios.expected_behavior: Sri Lankan New Year appropriate gifts, Kandy delivery, mother's preferences (traditional sweets, but she's gluten-free)

scenarios.name: Delivery to unavailable zone
scenarios.user_message: Can you deliver flowers to Kilinochchi tomorrow?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Inform user that Kilinochchi delivery is not currently available, suggest alternative pickup options

scenarios.name: Daughter dairy trap
scenarios.user_message: I want an ice cream cake for my daughter's birthday
scenarios.expected_behavior: Draft finds ice cream cakes, reflection catches dairy allergy (daughter is dairy-free), revise suggests dairy-free alternatives
scenarios.notes: Daughter Nethmi has severe dairy allergy - ice cream cakes are pure dairy
